Name: Wallet Tools
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b]Wallet Tools[/b] frees up backpack space by moving your main tools into the Special Items & Powers wallet page. 
Your Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Watering Can, Pan, Milk Pail and Shears stay available when you need them, without sitting in your inventory all day.

To use the forge for enhancements simply use your assigned hotkey and it will pull the tool out for enhancement. You can use the hotkeys to cycle between tools.

It uses the logic from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21050]Automate Tool Swap[/url].

You can also use configurable hotkeys to use the tools manually.

Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url].

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47465]Animal Husbandry Addon[/url].

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42725]Tool Upgrade Bundles[/url] you will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47706]Tool Upgrade Bundles Addon[/url]. 

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] you will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47822]Tractor Mod Addon[/url].

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies [/url]you will also need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48155]Nooks and Crannies Addon.[/url]

It also has its own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] app.

[color=#ff0000][size=4]Known Compatibility Issues:[/size][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7842]Mail Services[/url]: when using upgrades through the mail. You will need to turn off mail return for tool upgrades.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39047]Instant Tool Upgrades For Costs[/url]: when having a tool returned and you do not have an open inventory slot the tool will disappear. [color=#ffff00][size=3]INSTEAD [/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3]use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47685]Instant Tool Upgrades Redux[/url]. The Redux is also fully cost configurable.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Honorable Mentions:[/size][/color]

A shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CraftyFirebird]CraftyFirebird[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/blazesrequiem]blazesrequiem[/url] for their bug finding work. They have been instrumental.

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]A TIP FOR YOU:[/size][/color]
If you find removing placed items to be tedious with this installed change your pickaxe hotkey to something like left shift + left mouse.
